text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Champions Cup. Thanks to 
the PR efforts, a huge crowd gathered to 
cheer for Hokko Tarumae. Her social media 
is flooded with replies too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the paddock, Hokko Tarumae flinches 
under the pressure of the front line of 
dirt racing, but regains her composure 
thanks to Wonder Acute's reassuring words.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admonishing herself never to lose, Hokko 
Tarumae proudly and powerfully declared 
that she would challenge Wonder Acute and 
the others with all her might!
